Line.DefaultText: Architecture, passed with a design I'll admit I stole a diagram from for next term's lecture. Water doesn't forgive a bad angle the way earth does, but you found the right one. A water-driven sawmill and grinding mill are within your skill now, real ones, not the toy models I sketch on the board. Combine it with a Metallurgy degree and you'll be casting your own forge fittings before the season turns.
